name: cache-conflict-layout-inconsistent-strides
hypothesis: Cannot implement the selected layout as specified. The supplied full512 kernel packs 64 FP32 values per K slice: a 256-byte stride and 128 KiB total. A 2,112-byte stride reserves 1,081,344 bytes across 512 slices, not 128 KiB plus 8 KiB. Also, 512 FP32 values plus 32 padding values require 2,176 bytes, not 2,112. The stated 65,664-byte footprint does not resolve these conflicts. An 8 KiB total increase would instead imply a 272-byte K stride. Choosing one of these incompatible layouts would change the selected experiment. No edits or tests were performed; no performance claim is made.
